items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBcElrIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--4be3c11536038145829dbcba17ca15bdea04981e/imagen.png) # 🇺🇾 Hay un límite de 35 competidores para el registro. * Leer el [Reglamento de la WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) para evitar posibles inconvenientes. * Esta competencia está abierta a competidores de cualquier nacionalidad, cualquier edad y a nuevos competidores, sin importar sus tiempos de resolución. * Se debe tener en cuenta que los competidores pueden ser descalificados en los casos que prevé el Reglamento de la WCA. No se realizan reembolsos de ningún tipo por descalificación, según el artículo [2l1](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2l1). * Los competidores deben llevar sus propios puzzles. * Los competidores tienen que estar presentes y listos para competir cuando se los llama, de no ser así, se penalizará al competidor con la descalificación del evento (de la ronda, no de toda la competencia), de acuerdo con el artículo [2u](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2u) del reglamento. * Es importante leer toda la información disponible en la página de la competencia. Ante cualquier duda consultar a los organizadores o a los delegados de la WCA. # 🇬🇧 Competitor limit: 35. * Read the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) to avoid any issue. * This competition is open to competitors of any nationality or age. * Note that competitors may be disqualified under the circumstances described in the WCA Regulations. A disqualified competitor is not eligible for the refund of any expenses due to participating in the competition, as per regulation [2l1](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2l1). * Competitors must bring their own puzzles. * Competitors must be present and ready to compete when called, otherwise the competitor will be penalized with the disqualification of the event, in accordance with regulation [2u](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2u) of the WCA Regulations. * It is important to read all the information available in the competition website. Feel free to contact the organizers or the WCA Delegates.

items.name: DFW Cubing Winter 2023
items.information: This competition is supported by [CubingUSA](https://cubingusa.org/). Note: This competition is on a Sunday. # ***NO OUTSIDE FOOD OR DRINK IS PERMITTED IN THE VENUE.*** - Please review the [competitor information](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/DFWCubingWinter2023#23365-competitor-information) tab before the competition. - Please review the other tabs for more information on the competition. Please note that the [schedule](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/DFWCubingWinter2023#competition-schedule) is subject to change, as we may hold events slightly earlier or later than shown depending on whether the competition is running ahead of schedule or behind schedule. 3x3 Finals will be done head to head if time permits.

items.information: Please always include your **name** and competition name in any email that you send to us. All competitors must read the "Competitor Information" tab prior to registering. Please read all tabs prior to the competition and regularly check your email for updates from us. All contact will be made by email. Only **one** guest per competitor will be allowed. Competitors ages 16 and older are encouraged to come alone.
